strengths: Strong closing line delivers genuine emotional self-accountability.
Night-time urban aesthetic in the final scene provides a resonant contemplative landing.
dropoff_causes: Mid-script shift to loosely related B-roll (tape crafting, makeup) softens narrative tension.
Deliberate, slow voiceover cadence may feel sluggish for fast scrollers.
repeat_next: Relatable behavioral callouts in opening lines
Contemplative final lingering shot to let the insight land
reduce_next: Overly abstract domestic B-roll that weakens relationship context
Blank digital mockups lacking authentic visual details
